title: Share of news coverage
subtitle: Articles mentioning each company per 10,000 English-language articles GDELT monitored
takeaway: Awaiting data: GDELT's history for Anthropic has not been collected yet (its API rate-limits long backfills).
assumptions: GDELT's monitored article set has shrunk and shifted since 2023, so a raw count would mislead. The chart is each company's share of that day's monitored articles.
Share = articles matching the company's search terms ÷ all monitored English articles, summed over the month. Raw counts are in the table.
Search terms match by words, so some unrelated articles are included, most for common words (Mistral, Cohere, Grok).
